# Nonprobate Transfer

Assets that pass outside the probate estate — revocable trusts, TOD deeds, POD accounts, JTWROS, beneficiary designations, superannuation/CPF/EPF nominations

Source: [`v3/nonprobate-transfer.json`](../../v3/nonprobate-transfer.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/nonprobate-transfer.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this nonprobate transfer within the INHERIT document |
| `transferType` | one of `revocable_trust`, `tod_deed`, `pod_account`, `jtwros`, `tenancy_by_entirety`, `beneficiary_designation`, `life_insurance_nomination`, `superannuation_nomination`, `cpf_nomination`, `epf_nomination`, `mandatory_savings_nomination` | yes | The mechanism by which this asset passes outside the probate estate |
| `designationType` | `string` | | More specific description of the transfer mechanism |
| `description` | `string` | | Free-text description of the nonprobate transfer |
| `trustId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a Trust.id if this transfer is via a revocable trust |
| `propertyId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a Property.id if this transfer relates to real estate (e.g. TOD deed, JTWROS property) |
| `assetIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | References to Asset.id(s) that pass via this nonprobate transfer |
| `beneficiaryPersonIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Person IDs of the primary beneficiaries or surviving owners who receive the asset |
| `contingentBeneficiaryPersonIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Person IDs of contingent beneficiaries who receive if the primary beneficiaries predecease |
| `survivingOwnerPersonIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Person IDs of surviving joint owners for JTWROS and tenancy by entirety transfers |
| `passesOutsideEstate` | `boolean` | yes | Confirmation that this asset passes outside the probate estate. Should always be true for nonprobate transfers |
| `bindingNomination` | `boolean` | | Whether the beneficiary nomination is legally binding on the fund trustee. Australian superannuation nominations may be binding (valid for 3 years) or non-binding (trustee has discretion) |
| `nominationExpiryDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the nomination expires, if applicable. Australian binding nominations expire after 3 years and must be renewed |
| `recordingReference` | `string` | | Recording or filing reference for the transfer instrument (e.g. county recorder reference for a TOD deed) |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | Jurisdiction governing this nonprobate transfer |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this nonprobate transfer |
| `designationConflict` | `object` | | Documents a conflict between this beneficiary designation and another instrument (will, later nomination, court order) |
| `revocationDetails` | `object` | | How and when a beneficiary designation was revoked |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
